title: The Middle Son — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: country blues acoustic guitar warm baritone male vocal storytelling 100bpm walking bass brushed drums character portrait unhurried Spanish French language learning family
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
There's a specific skill set that the middle son develops
In the space between the eldest and the youngest — that's the envelope
He learns to read the room before the room has read itself
He learns to make his way without the manual on the shelf

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
El hijo del medio tiene habilidades especiales
[The middle son has special skills]
En el espacio entre el mayor y el menor, sus señales
[In the space between the oldest and youngest, his signals]
Aprende a leer la habitación antes de que ella se lea
[He learns to read the room before the room reads itself]
El hijo del medio abre su propio camino con su marea
[The middle son opens his own path with his tide]

[Chorus — English]
The middle son, the middle son
Not the first to go and not the last one done
The middle son finds his own particular road
Between the family's history and his own chosen code
That's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
Le fils du milieu développe des compétences propres
[The middle son develops his own skills]
Dans l'espace entre l'aîné et le cadet — ce propre
[In the space between the eldest and the youngest — this own space]
Il apprend à lire la pièce avant que la pièce se lise
[He learns to read the room before the room reads itself]
Le fils du milieu trace sa route avec sa propre franchise
[The middle son charts his route with his own directness]

[Outro — All three languages]
The middle son knows… El hijo del medio sabe… Le fils du milieu sait
He builds from the centre — Construye desde el centro — Il construit depuis le centre
That's my boy
